rules.text: The page is A4 and every margin is at least 15 mm.
Body text, including text in tables, is at least 11 points.
Line spacing is at least single and character spacing is standard.
Sections 1 Excellence (1.1, 1.2), 2 Impact (2.1, 2.2, optional 2.3) and 3 Quality and efficiency of the implementation (3.1, 3.2) are headings in that order.
The title, list of participants and sections 1 to 3 together are at most 40 pages, or 45 for lump-sum topics.
